reply.observation: I held the cup in front of the person on their left. They pointed across it toward the tabletop on their right, then withdrew their hand without taking it.
reply.interpretation: They may have been showing me where to set the drink down.
reply.title: Drink placement on the table
reply.note: The person may prefer drinks set down in front of them on their right. This is based on one gesture.
reply.question: Was the spot in front of you on your right where you usually want drinks, or was it specific to this cup?
